headline: Record revenue and EPS as AI demand lifts outlook
summary_short: Applied Materials posted record Q2 FY2026 revenue of $7.91B, up 11.4% y/y, with record GAAP diluted EPS of $3.51 (+33.5% y/y) and record non-GAAP diluted EPS of $2.86 (+19.7% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue rose 11.4% y/y to a record $7.91B; GAAP gross margin was 49.9% (+0.8ppt) and operating margin 31.9% (+1.4ppt). Net income reached $2.81B (+31.3%) and diluted EPS a record $3.51 (+33.5%); non-GAAP diluted EPS was also a record $2.86 (+19.7%). Growth was driven by AI demand across leading-edge logic, DRAM, and advanced packaging; Semiconductor Systems revenue rose to $5.97B and Applied Global Services to $1.67B. Operating cash flow was $845M, but non-GAAP free cash flow fell 80.2% y/y to $210M on working-capital and capex. The company raised its dividend 15% to $0.53/share. Guidance: Q3 FY2026 revenue $8,950M +/- $500M, non-GAAP EPS $3.36 +/- $0.20; management now expects semiconductor equipment revenue to grow over 30% in calendar 2026.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited the rapid global build-out of AI computing infrastructure plus Applied's leadership in leading-edge logic, DRAM, and advanced packaging as the foundation for the quarter and raised the outlook for semiconductor-equipment growth in calendar 2026 to more than 30%.
Both reporting segments grew y/y: Semiconductor Systems revenue rose to $5,965M from $5,401M and Applied Global Services rose to $1,665M from $1,420M.
Semiconductor Systems segment gross margin expanded to 54.7% from 53.5% y/y, lifting the consolidated GAAP gross margin.
GAAP EPS growth (+33.5%) outpaced non-GAAP EPS growth (+19.7%) because GAAP net income included a $685M unrealized gain on strategic investments that non-GAAP results exclude.
Free cash flow fell as net change in operating assets and liabilities used $1,750M of cash (vs $723M a year ago) and capital expenditures rose to $635M from $510M.
